name: closure list freshness
code:
def mk():
    a = []
    a.append(1)
    return a
x = mk()
y = mk()
print(x, y)
def mk2(n):
    d = {}
    d['n'] = n
    return d
p = mk2(1)
q = mk2(2)
print(p, q)

name: closure tuple freshness

name: attr alias writers
code:

        self.v = []
